title:
Seized luxury condos at auction.
*Bargain?*

lines.say: You are a buyer. You hear seized luxury condos are going to auction. You think, bargain.
lines.cap: you hear seized condos are going to auction. *bargain?*

lines.say: These were seized in Singapore's three billion dollar money laundering case. More than 80 properties are being sold.
lines.cap: seized in the *$3 billion* money laundering case

lines.say: In September, 26 went under the hammer. Only 4 sold. The rest were withdrawn.
The ones that sold went for just 1 to 7% below their opening price. Two Martin Modern units sold close to their previous prices.
lines.cap: sold at just *1 to 7% below* opening price
lines.stat: Martin Modern: close to previous prices

lines.say: Next, on 28 October. Six freehold units near Orchard. Nouvel 18's guide prices run from about twenty nine hundred, to thirty six hundred psf.
lines.cap: 28 Oct: 6 freehold units. guide *~$2,900 to $3,600 psf*

lines.say: Its recent resales? About twenty eight hundred, to thirty five hundred psf. Roughly the same.
lines.cap: recent resales: *~$2,800 to $3,500 psf*. roughly the same

lines.say: So an auction doesn't mean cheap. Reserve prices are usually set close to valuation.
lines.cap: auction ≠ cheap. reserves are *usually close to valuation*

lines.say: The real test never changes. Compare against what that project has already sold for.
lines.cap: the real test: *what the project already sold for*

lines.say: With a dependable framework, we've found units two to three hundred thousand dollars below market. No auction needed.
lines.cap: we've found units *$200K to $300K below market*

lines.say: Want to know how? Comment find, or send us a message.
lines.cap: want to know how? comment *FIND* or DM us

caption:
Seized luxury condos from the $3B money laundering case are going to auction. 🔨 But in September, only 4 of 26 sold, at just 1 to 7% below opening price. An auction isn't automatically a bargain.

With a dependable framework, we've found units $200K to $300K below market, without waiting for an auction. Want to know how? Comment FIND or DM us 👇

Based on past transactions. Every unit and situation is different.
